# Review protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the supplied invented learning-garden records report about recall?

## Scope and inclusion criteria

Include both supplied records and preserve every supplied claim, citation identity, source passage, and synthesis sentence exactly. Include all supplied years and settings. No population, language, or study-design restriction beyond membership in the supplied input applies.

## Exclusion criteria
Exclude outside records and any invented additions to the supplied evidence. Do not infer methods, sample sizes, effect sizes, or bibliographic identifiers absent from the supplied records.

## Authorization

## Input and query log

Source: input.json, copied from the supplied public fixture when no input file was present.
Local corpus import: two supplied records; two included; none excluded; no duplicates merged.
No search queries executed. External searching, acquisition, and snowballing are inapplicable to these entirely invented records. The provided source passages are the complete available synthetic source material, not independently retrieved publications.

## Reading and synthesis

Synthesis wording and claim/source bindings are copied without correction or reinterpretation. The supplied reference list is empty and retained as supplied.

## Retrieval summary
Both synthetic source passages are available locally. No additional source documents were supplied or requested. The fulltext field records local availability of the complete supplied passage only.

## Phase boundary
Artifact capture ends after writing the workspace. No citation verification, claim verification, plugin validation, repair, or delivery phase is executed. No verification report is fabricated.
